description: Detects when Ant Table columns reference fields that don't exist in the data records. Catches silent rendering failures where UI shows empty values.

detects: dataIndex value doesn't match any field in record object
render function accesses field that isn't in data transformation
Parent transforms data (e.g., candidate_name → name) but child expects original field names
Table columns reference snake_case but data has camelCase (or vice versa)

examples_that_trigger.issue: Parent transforms candidate_name → name, table expects candidate_name
examples_that_trigger.reason: render() tries to access record.candidate_name but record only has 'name' after transformation

examples_that_trigger.code: { title: 'Email', dataIndex: 'email' } but data has { candidate_email: 'x@y.com' }

rule_1.name: Check dataIndex matches record fields
rule_1.check: For each column with dataIndex, verify that the dataIndex key exists in 100% of records
rule_1.implementation: Parse Ant Table columns configuration + data structure; cross-reference
rule_1.auto_fix: Use consistent field names or add field mapping layer

rule_2.name: Detect data transformation mismatches
rule_2.check: If parent component transforms data, child component must either: (a) not transform, or (b) transform consistently
rule_2.implementation: Track mapCandidate calls; verify output field names match table expectations
rule_2.auto_fix: Either don't transform in parent, or ensure child handles both original and transformed names

rule_3.name: Verify field presence in render functions
rule_3.check: Any record?.field_name access in render functions must have corresponding field in data
rule_3.implementation: Static analysis of render functions vs data schema

rule_4.name: Detect silent empty renders
rule_4.check: If {record?.field} renders as empty string/nothing, it means field is undefined
rule_4.implementation: Linting rule to warn on empty JSX renders with optional chaining

prevention_strategy.point_1: Use type definitions (TypeScript) to define expected data shape
prevention_strategy.point_2: Add runtime validation: verify all dataIndex fields exist before rendering table
prevention_strategy.point_3: Normalize data in ONE place only (either parent or child, not both)
prevention_strategy.point_4: Add console.error if field is missing (catch during development)

git_commit_enforcement.message: Field mismatch detected: table columns reference undefined fields. This will render as empty in UI.

before.parent: const data = mapCandidate(apiData, 'ant');  // Transforms candidate_name → name

after_option_a.description: Normalize in child component to handle both field name formats

after_option_b.description: Use consistent field names everywhere (prefer candidate_name since API uses it)
after_option_b.change: Remove mapCandidate transformation of candidate_name; keep it as-is

test_case.name: Ant Table Field Mismatch Detection
test_case.setup: Create table with dataIndex='candidate_name' but data has { name: 'Jane' } only
test_case.expected: Gate BLOCKS commit with error message about missing field
test_case.actual_before_rule: Bug committed; users see empty Name column at runtime

learned_date: 2026-09-04 (Candidate names display bug - 50+ hour production outage)
impact: CRITICAL - Silent rendering failure; no errors in console; users see empty UI with no indication of what's wrong
